name: Nectar
summary: Nectar sells Recognize, Comms and Engage separately or as a Nectar One bundle, and publishes no prices. Every plan routes to a demo request. Recognize covers peer and manager recognition, a points system with a global catalog and recognition analytics.

facts.text: Nectar Recognize lists peer-to-peer and manager recognition, points-based rewards with flexible budgets, and a global reward catalog of gift cards, Amazon, swag and custom rewards.
No dollar figure for any plan appears on the pricing page. The Get pricing button links to the demo page at /get-a-demo, not to a price list.
Nectar One combines Recognize, Engage and Comms. Nectar Perform is marked as coming soon.

plans.name: Nectar Recognize
plans.notes: No price published. Demo request required

plans.name: Nectar One
plans.notes: Bundle of Recognize, Engage and Comms. No price published

hiddenCosts: No prices, minimums or trial terms are published, so reward budgets and contract length need to be confirmed in a quote.
